about: The shared core of FlowKy and FlowKy Pro. These files exist only here; FlowKy Pro's build takes them from this folder at a commit pinned in its core.lock.json and refuses any other copy. Every other file of this folder belongs to the free plugin alone. A core file may import only other core files and the per-plugin interface files below, which each plugin provides for itself.

interface.hooks/baseline.ts: the plugin's dispatcher: export dispatch(io, event, input, runtime, wait?, args?)
interface.hooks/identity.ts: the plugin's name, version, mods command and handoff skill
interface.mods/config.ts: the plugin's config: loadConfig(io, root) with at least the map and context sections
